notes.title: BRAND SPANKIN' NEW UPDATE!
notes.content:
Welcome to the first major HyperFleet update! Here's what has been added!

[h3]CloutCoin/Hangar:[/h3]
A (fictional) cryptocurrency you can buy/earn to get cool new ships!

[h3]Time Trials/Ghost Replays[/h3]
Race against yourself or other players via LIVE ghost replays!

[h3]Practice mode:[/h3]
Practice the levels without the threat of crashing!

[h3]Flight School:[/h3]
Learn the basics of the game with Snoob Goob!

[h3]Discord:[/h3]
HyperFleet now has a dedicated Discord server: https://discord.gg/5wZ9Nf3NZg

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
-Ultra-wide monitor support (21:9)
-Level collider optimization
-Offline functionality

As a thank you for the support, anyone who owned the game prior to this update got 1000 Clout Coins added to their account. Enjoy ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: HyperFleet Devlog 10.01.21
notes.content:
Hey there pilots!

Here is some information to get you excited about future updates! These are all features that are either currently being worked on, or are planned to be implemented:

[b]Flight School[/b]
Snoob Goob talks you through the basics of the game hands-on! Currently not final, but plans are to separate them by type (Basic Movement, Boosts, Twist Gates, Advanced Strategies, etc). Hopefully, this will make the game easier to learn!

[b]Practice Mode[/b]
In this mode, you can play through any of your unlocked courses without the threat of crashing or missing a twist gate. However, your time and stars will not be saved if you finish.

[b]Time Trials/Ghost Racing[/b]
Race against a ghost of someone on the leaderboards and try to beat their time! Upload your own replay to show off your skills!

[b]Ship Hanger[/b]
Buy cool ship skins to show off your clout in your time trials replay!

Thank you so much for the support, see you soon!
